name: dv360-mcp
description: Google Display & Video 360 (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps t

platform_mcp_dv360_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_dv360_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id of a Google Cloud project with the Display & Video 360 API enabled.

platform_mcp_dv360_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_dv360_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

platform_mcp_dv360_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_dv360_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/display-video, for a user with a DV360 user profile (Admin/Standard for writes).

platform_mcp_dv360_partner_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_PARTNER_ID
platform_mcp_dv360_partner_id.description: DV360 partner id whose advertisers list_accounts returns (GET /v4/advertisers requires partnerId).

platform_mcp_dv360_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DV360_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_dv360_advertiser_id.description: DV360 advertiser id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v4/advertisers/{advertiserId}/campaigns/{campaignId}).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v4/partners?pageSize=1: confirms the token and DV360 access ({partners: [{partnerId, displayName, entityStatus}]}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v4/advertisers?partnerId={partner_id config}: the partner's advertisers. Only the first page is returned (pageToken paging).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v4/advertisers/{account_id}/campaigns (account_id = advertiser id). `status` is active, paused or archived (archived campaigns are hidden unless asked for). Planned budgets are in raw.campaignBudgets (budgetAmountMicros over a date range); start/end are {year, month, day} objects. First page only.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /v4/advertisers/{advertiser_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id}?updateMask=entityStatus {entityStatus: ENTITY_STATUS_PAUSED|ENTITY_STATUS_ACTIVE}. Resuming lets its insertion orders spend again.
